title: OpenCode LSP runtime smoke receipt
description: Machine-readable strict LSP activation evidence after opening a supported file. Distinguishes configuration proof from runtime activation; fails closed on verbatim server error.

repositoryRoot.description: Canonical repo root verified by origin + HEAD

fileOpenedToTriggerLsp.description: Relative path opened exactly once to trigger LSPs will activate as files are read

activeLspServerAfterOpening.description: Empty or verbatim No LSP server available / No results found when not active; pyright when active

exactErrors.description: Verbatim tool/server errors, e.g. No results found for hover

pyrightVersion.description: null when pyright absent; e.g. 1.1.414 when installed

proofCeiling.const: Runtime activation requires opening a supported .py or .yml file and observing hover/definition/references; configuration proof (lsp=true overlay/launcher) alone is not runtime proof; PowerShell has no built-in LSP and remains validator-owned.
